releaseNotesSummary: Unsigned pre-1.0 release package with the #326 second-pass bughunt fix wave: redacted support bundles preserve diagnostic vocabulary while still redacting sensitive free-form values, explicit reparse-point targets are scanned by operator intent while nested reparse points remain skipped and logged, missing share-gate conflict noise is deduped and broad share gates are recognized, inheritance-break propagation uses real path ancestry rather than sibling string prefixes, local folder scans verify same-named SMB share paths before attaching share-level permissions, native NetSessionEnum pagination treats ERROR_MORE_DATA pages as usable evidence, review-decision imports protect existing reviewed decisions from stale drafts, and current operator quickstarts reference the v0.1.0-pre.28 release root. The package also includes the built PowerShell module files, startup launcher, diagnostic scripts, documentation, hashes, release manifest, dependency-age report, and prebuilt standalone dashboard template assets.
